start_frame: Low reverse from the burrow mouth out across the field, hawthorn stems making a dark frame at the edges: Alice small, coming out of the long grass straight toward camera, the S01 elm pinned small and clear in the background centre.
end_frame: The same frame with her much larger in it, still coming on and still not looking back at the elm behind her.
constraint_honoured: 'Static — the first check in the acceleration': after the handheld travelling shot the cut lands on a nailed-down frame, which is what makes the chase feel like it is gaining.
movement_note: 3.0 s is too short to develop any move, and a move would soften the deliberate rhythmic check this shot exists to make.
